about_the_game:
Earth has been invaded by demons many years ago. The demon rulers have slaved, tortured and killed everyone who resisted. You decide to fight back! The demons found out you were plotting a rebellion against them and the demons are now hunting you as an enemy of the state. Your goal is to start a rebellion and overthrow the evil demon rulers and their minions.

Demo Features:

  • 10 weapons with alternate firing modes. You have weapons like automatic Magnum Pistols, a double barreled Shotgun, rapid fire Submachineguns, a powerful Grenade Launcher and a high tech Lightning Buzzsaw.

  • Over 10 enemies ranging from easy cannon fodder Troopers to dangerous Demon Knights and blood thirsty Brute Butchers.

  • Your journey takes you through Episode 1: Purrfect Rebellion with its industrial complexes and cityscapes. Plenty of secrets to discover.

  • There's also a survival mode where you fight against the ever-growing army of the demons in the deathmatch level until they overwhelm you.

  • Play up to 4 player local split screen multiplayer in co-op, deathmatch and survival modes. XInput compatible controllers/gamepads needed for split screen multiplayer. There is an auto aim setting that can be used when playing with gamepads.

  • Optional 256 color palette shader for a more retro look.

  • Nonstop Mäyhem!

short_description: Fast paced action first person shooter. Earth has been invaded by demons who have slaved, tortured and killed everyone who resisted. You decide to fight back! Slaughter large masses of evil demons, zombies and other monsters in colorful environments. The game runs on FTEQW engine.
